profile.headline: Solutions/ Technical Architect
profile.summary:
A motivated and accomplished solutions / technical architect with a demonstrated history of success in software systems analysis, design and development, microservices, agile methodology, cloud migrations, CI-CD pipelines, SQL/NoSQL DBs, Infrastructure as a Code, web services, and vulnerability management. Experienced in leading successful projects, training and developing staff, and collaborating cross-functionally. Proven aptitude for implementing strategies and solutions to ensure quality, drive efficiency, and achieve and exceed goals.

TECHINCAL SKILLS: 
Platforms: Ubuntu Linux, MacOS, Windows
Software: AWS, JDK 17, 1.8, openJdk11, Spring Boot, Spring, Microservices, Webservices
Methodologies: AWS Cloud Services(EC2, ECS, S3, IAM, Lambda, ECR, Route53, ELBs, API Gateways), CI/CD pipelines(bitbucket, jenkins, tower), Agile Methodologies(SAFE), BizDesign, LucidCharts
Databases: Postgres Aurora, MongoDB, Cassandra, Solr Cloud, Oracle, MS Access, MySQL, Hadoop/Hive, Informix
Languages / Scripts: Java, Python, PHP5, C/C++, JavaScript, Spring, Hibernate, VBScript, Visual Basic, JSP, XML, EJB, Servlet, Web services, Microsoft .Net
Version Control tools: Git, AWS codeCommit, SVN, Harvest 5.1 and 7.1, Rational clear case

positions.title: Technical Solutions Architect
positions.description:
• Provided solutions and strategies for consumer relationship systems and legal, and compliance. 
• Led AWS migration efforts and moved multiple applications to AWS before deadline by providing cost effective, secure, resilient, and scalable solutions. 
• Defined and documented solution architecture and roadmap, including identification of technical and functional components, data flow, and security requirements.
• Advocated and drove adoption of architecture patterns, design principles, and leading practices including microservices, containerization, and DevSecOps to ensure standards-based architectures across the Legal and Compliance department as it continues its cloud journey with AWS.
• Worked with multiple teams in designing cross dependency solutions, mentoring offshore-onshore team members and providing technical guidance and code reviews. 
• Led efforts of vulnerability management to ensure that software and applications were not vulnerable. 
Presented solutions in front of the solutions architecture committee.
• Led PoC/PoT of new technology solutions to evaluate solutions that are fit-for-purpose & aligned to TU Technology strategy.
• Led analysis of the technology landscape to identify gaps, technical debt, and recommend solutions towards cost optimization, improved operations, and solution sustainability.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Scaled Agile Framework · Cross-team Collaboration · Automation · Vulnerability Management · Application Engineering · Capacity Planning · DevOps · Technical Execution · Microservices · Technical Vision · Communication · Analytics · Optimization · Consulting · Solution Architecture · Load Balancing · Oracle Database · Leadership · Proactive Monitoring · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · High Performance Teams · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · System Configuration · Agile Project Management · Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
• Collaborated with business leaders and other stakeholders to understand business and technical requirements and initiative objectives.
• Assisted with design, develop and document end-to-end technical solutions for complex business problems in partnership with the Enterprise Architecture team.
• Advocated and helped drive adoption of “best practices” to ensure standardization of solution architecture outputs across the online teams.
• Stayed up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends and provide recommendations for adoption of new technologies and tools.
• Supported and worked on multiple online platforms, including search, data quality, and content. Built and developed multiple microservices for multiple teams.
• Led migration of search platform to cloud. Helped build solutions, providing strategy and identifying gaps. 
• Designed and developed item matching program for multiple systems, enabling grouping of similar items and removing duplicate search results page,  developed metrics / utilities to show improvement of matching with each project release. 
• Developed multiple web services to offer marketplace sellers opportunity to associate offer data with existing content, developed real-time inventory for fulfillment optimization and led assortment monitoring and management project to increase assortment of catalog.
• Worked across various teams and divisions in organization to support development, QA, maintenance, and implementation of Java applications and ensure that assigned projects were achieved within established timeframes and budgets.
• Received Super Star Award twice.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer/ Software Engineer III
positions.description:
• Worked on upgrading to Informix Mach 11 and implementing enhanced Solr Search experience on website. Project remediated max capacity risk to support 2012 home services busy season and incorporated new search capabilities. 
• Created web service that increased customer’s ability to easily find replacement parts and integrated shopping and cart / checkout experience between websites. 
• Received Sears Technology Excellence Award (TEA).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Handled the suite of online and backend tools for use by our business, affiliates and advertisers. The tools are used to maintain Listings, Broker, Agent and Builder data.
•	Developed an online sales tool and a widget that enables agents to buy a package with HomeFinder.com and enhance their listings.
•	Optimized application performance to ensure a rich end user experience for web-based applications
•	Implemented automated unit tests to find application defects and prevent regression.
positions.insights: Skills: Cross-team Collaboration · Communication · Analytics · Optimization · System Configuration

positions.title: Management Analyst
positions.description:
• Developed programs in Java to generate reports for evaluating capacity performance of each device.
Worked with QA and database teams to understand business processes to meet client’s requirement.
• Developed programs in Java to parse XML file and store data into CSV files to provide view of performance and capacity of connections and components throughout entire networked infrastructure.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Involved in building and testing OMAP software releases for Nokia OMAPSW 8.X and 9.X.
• Involved in building Baseport (Symbian O.S) and DSPBridge and creating textshell and techview images to perform E32, F32, and bridge samples testing.
• Debugged C++ code. Involved in MMF testing to test Audio codec, Video codec, and Speech codec.
